question:
Gautam buys 5 pens, 3 bags and 1 instrument box and pays a sum of 160. From the same shop, Vikram buys 2 pens, 1 bag and 3 instrument boxes and pays a sum of 190. Also Ankur buys 1 pen, 2 bags and 4 instrument boxes and pays a sum of 250.

**(I)** Convert the given above situation into a matrix equation of the form $AX=B$.
**(II)** Find $|A|$.
**(III)** Find $A^{-1}$.
OR
**(III)** Determine $P=A^{2}-5A$.
explanation:
**(I)** **Step 1:** Let the price of 1 pen be $x$, 1 bag be $y$, and 1 instrument box be $z$. Based on the given data, the equations are $5x + 3y + z = 160$, $2x + y + 3z = 190$, and $x + 2y + 4z = 250$.
**Step 2:** This system can be written as $AX = B$: $\left[\begin{matrix}5&3&1\\ 2&1&3\\ 1&2&4\end{matrix}\right] \left[\begin{matrix}x\\ y\\ z\end{matrix}\right] = \left[\begin{matrix}160\\ 190\\ 250\end{matrix}\right]$.

**(II)** **Step 1:** Find $|A|$ by expanding along row 1: $|A| = 5(1(4) - 3(2)) - 3(2(4) - 3(1)) + 1(2(2) - 1(1))$.
**Step 2:** Compute values: $5(4 - 6) - 3(8 - 3) + 1(4 - 1) = 5(-2) - 3(5) + 1(3) = -10 - 15 + 3 = -22$.

**(III)** **Step 1:** Find the cofactors of matrix A: $A_{11}=-2, A_{12}=-5, A_{13}=3; A_{21}=-10, A_{22}=19, A_{23}=-7; A_{31}=8, A_{32}=-13, A_{33}=-1$. The transpose of the cofactor matrix yields $\text{adj } A = \left[\begin{matrix}-2&-10&8\\ -5&19&-13\\ 3&-7&-1\end{matrix}\right]$.
**Step 2:** Calculate $A^{-1} = \frac{1}{|A|}\text{adj } A = \frac{1}{-22}\left[\begin{matrix}-2&-10&8\\ -5&19&-13\\ 3&-7&-1\end{matrix}\right]$.

**OR**

**(III)** **Step 1:** Calculate $A^2$: $\left[\begin{matrix}5&3&1\\ 2&1&3\\ 1&2&4\end{matrix}\right] \left[\begin{matrix}5&3&1\\ 2&1&3\\ 1&2&4\end{matrix}\right] = \left[\begin{matrix}32&20&18\\ 15&13&17\\ 13&13&23\end{matrix}\right]$.
**Step 2:** Calculate $5A = \left[\begin{matrix}25&15&5\\ 10&5&15\\ 5&10&20\end{matrix}\right]$. Subtract to find $P = A^2 - 5A = \left[\begin{matrix}7&5&13\\ 5&8&2\\ 8&3&3\end{matrix}\right]$.
